Sasha: Product needs a pragmatic EU tenant cutover checklist we can hand to customers. They asked for clear launch criteria, rollback gates, and a minimal runbook. Can someone sketch the bare minimum?
Priya: From PM: customer asks are zero perceived downtime, data-stays-in-region, 10% canary, and ability to revert within 15m. Keep it simple.
Carlos: Infra constraints: we must list capacity reservation (N+X headroom), a pre-warm KV cache step, and a model-variant fallback policy. Also require a config audit before cutover.
Liam: Ops wants: runbook with step-by-step for canary, manual stop / force-fail action in Console, and checklist for scaling knobs. Also need an oncall rotation during the 72h post-cutover window.
Olive: Question: do we do tenant slices (dedicated) or tag-based shared slices with soft isolation? For most standard customers, tagging + affinity is cheaper.
Sasha: Let's default to tag-based isolation; only enterprise / regulated customers get dedicated slices by contract. Capture that in acceptance matrix.
Maya: Add a quality validation step: run the customer's canonical prompt suite and compare embeddings/generation quality to an agreed baseline; fail if beyond tolerance.
Eli: Networking note: cross-region affinity options: replicate KV (adds write replication complexity) OR route back to origin (egress + latency). Document tradeoffs and recommended default (route-back to origin) for now.
Priya: Proposed SLA commitments: hosted customers -> 99.9% uptime, p95 <= 200ms. Dedicated -> 99.95% and p95 <= 150ms, contingent on reserved capacity.
Carlos: Canary definition proposal: 10% traffic for 30 minutes, auto rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 increases > 20%. Also require KV warmup job to run 15m before canary.
Sasha: Drafted minimal launch criteria: 
- Signed pre-cutover checklist (capacity, runbook, data residency flags)
- Canary: 10% traffic, 30m, rollback triggers as above
- Quality gate: customer eval set within X% of baseline (embedding distance/generation metrics)
- Observability: token-level cost delta review, trace sampling enabled, alerting configured
- Access control: only role=ops can initiate cutovers (Console + API), with confirmation modal and 2FA for Console
- Fallbacks: model-variant fallback + region-fallback policy present
Example routing policy we might encode in rollout config:
```
{"policy":"weighted","buckets":{"primary-eu":0.9,"canary-eu":0.1},"rollback": {"error_pct":0.5,"p95_bump_pct":20}}
```
Priya: Add monitoring clause: 72-hour heightened monitoring window after cutover, with quality alerts tied to the customer's prompt set and a weekly check-in for the first month.
Olive: UX: we should provide an API-first flow plus a Console quick action. Console action needs confirmation, role gating, and a one-line summary of current canary metrics before you click.
Liam: Operational detail: require a pre-approved cold-start budget and autoscale headroom in the contract. Also require a verified traffic profile from the customer to size reservations.
Eli: I'm going to draft the KV replication vs route-back decision doc and include cost/latency numbers. Carlos will do capacity reservation template.
Carlos: I'll own capacity/reservation template + automated pre-cutover config audit. Sasha can own the acceptance checklist doc and coordinate signatures.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-routing-eu-v5 -> 4 nodes eu-west on 2026-05-12T09:00:00Z
Sasha: OK I'll create the checklist doc and schedule a 30m sync with infra, ops, and product for tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
